entities.summary: Erasmo Carlos was a Brazilian singer and songwriter, most closely associated with his friend and longtime collaborator Roberto Carlos. Together, they created many chart hits including "É proibido fumar", "Sentado à beira do caminho", "Além do horizonte", "Amigo" and "Festa de arromba". Erasmo Carlos was a composers & musicians from Rio de Janeiro (1941-06-05, Rio de Janeiro–2022-11-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
